correctness.rationale: The deterministic graft identity H=max_v(K_v+sum_{external edges}(1+left/right record spine length of parent)) reduces the problem to finitely many independent uniform BST blocks. Independent online relative ranks give left/right record path means log m+O(1), variances log m+O(1) and covariance O(1), hence asymptotically independent Gaussian edge labels by multivariate Lindeberg. Positive fixed block masses give N_i proportional to n; published Reed uniform BST mean c*log n-beta loglog n+O(1), bounded variance, make internal K_v deviations o(sqrt(log n)). Shallow external vertices have at least log n deterministic deficit, so only deepest v survive. Uniform integrability follows second-moment bounds and finite external k; first moment converges. Separately constructed 1350 small BSTs and computed heights from grafting and direct insertion, all agreeing.
